title: Only one inspection is priced, however many the deal books
evidence: shared/orchestration/trade_costs.py:275 inspection = landed_cost.inspection_usd_per_shipment() once per deal; the buyer's plan can add DUPRO and PEO (shared/orchestration/inspection_plan.py, deal.inspection_types) and a failed QC books a re-inspection (playbooks.py:82); services/escrow_guard/service.py:1969 _COSTS_BY_ORDER books the 'inspection' line once unless the provider order reports its own fee; the rework notice (notifications.py:629) never tells the supplier the re-inspection is at its cost
impact: DUPRO + PSI + PEO is three QIMA man-days (~USD 900-1,200) priced as one (~USD 350); every re-inspection after the supplier's own failure is paid by PortLess
fix: Price one inspection per planned phase (cost sheet line per type, buyer band and walk-away follow); book each QC order's cost in the ledger; charge a re-inspection to the supplier (deducted from its next payout, stated in the PO terms and the rework notice)
why_money: the inspection plan the buyer asks for is paid for in the price, not out of the margin
